title: Rite content, 2026-11 weeks 3–4 (2 – 15 Nov 2026)
notes: Calendar: `docs/launch-kit-v2.md` (i), weeks 3 and 4 (calendar days 15–28). Rendered from `content/` against a local `wrangler dev --local` (no live-site rows). Card data built with `TODAY=2026-11-02`; every date on screen and in every VO script checked by `bun clips/check-cohorts.ts --plan` (cohort clips on their own posting day, card facts, celebrity passes recomputed with `compute()`, spoken dates parsed back from words).

Regenerate (from `content/`, one command): `TODAY=2026-11-02 bun scripts/render-batch.ts --plan scripts/plan-2026-11-weeks-3-4.json --dest 2026-11-weeks-3-4` (date check → dial clips + backdrop stills → cards → this folder → `content/out/2026-11-weeks-3-4.zip`).

**Voiceover: this export is silent** (no ElevenLabs key in the render environment). Every reel that should have a voice has its spoken lines written: dial clips in `clips/cohorts.json` (`vo`), card verticals in `clips/card-vo.json`; one row per take in `scripts/vo-lines-2026-11-weeks-3-4.tsv` (`path<TAB>text`). Voice: ElevenLabs v3 "Anna" for everything; numbers and dates are spelled out in the VO text, captions stay in digits. To add the voice: generate each row as `<VO_DIR>/<path>.mp3` (or .wav) and re-run the command above with `VO_PROVIDER=files VO_DIR=<dir>` in front (or just `ELEVENLABS_API_KEY=…`, which synthesises the same lines). Each reel then also gets a `_vo` file, timed to the takes: dial-clip beats follow the spoken lines, a card vertical lasts its take + 1.6 s (the silent card renders here are estimated at 2.6 words a second, so the VO versions will differ by a second or two). No music, ever: add it in the app's reel editor.
**Domain flag:** every asset and caption says **rite.report**; check it resolves before posting (the site was at rite.mickreal.workers.dev when weeks 1–2 were made).

**Need a person or credits:** Thu 5 and Sat 14 (style 4 creator reposts) are made by hand; each has a fallback video that goes out unless the original is ready. Thu 12 (style 3 on integration) is an Anna-light presenter reel that posts as its interim version (no Anna, no voice) until `npm run presenter:prep -- integration-1996` has made it. The four style 5 celebrity pieces (Mon 2 Simone Biles, Wed 4 Aniston + Jenner, Fri 6 Sabrina Carpenter, Tue 10 Craig + Biles) are green-screen reactions that need a creator: for each there is a no-person stand-in to post (a captioned dial clip of the dates, or a quote card with the dates for the pairs) plus the caption-free result screens as green-screen backdrops.

**Kit corrections (checked with `compute()`):** (1) the week-4 line "Daniel Craig + Simone Biles (both have December passes)" is wrong for Craig: his passes are 20 May 2026, 5 Oct 2026 and 11 Feb 2027. The Tue 10 card says what holds: both three-pass in the same loop, with the 11 Dec 2026 station inside both runs. (2) Second-return three-pass band: born 30 Jan – 30 Mar 1968, not 29 Jan (29 Jan 1968 is 7.90° Aries, one pass); carousel 3 uses 30 Jan. (3) Post 3 says the 11 Dec station is "the closest it gets without crossing": half of that band (natal 7.9–8.9° Aries, e.g. Simone Biles) is crossed three times; the copy here drops "without crossing". (4) Post 7 / Script 3 say the site emails "the week before" the window opens; the site's result page says one email a month before; the Sun 8 re-cut says a month.

**Time-sensitive (post on the day, or check the line first):** Mon 9 Post 3 variant says "just over four weeks" until 11 Dec (true 7 – 12 Nov). Tue 3 Script 4 VO says "this year" for May and October 2026, Tue 10 Craig + Biles VO says "from May this year", Wed 11 1969 clip says "next April" (16 Apr 2027): all 2026 only. Mon 2 Simone, Mon 9 closest turn and Tue 10 Craig + Biles talk about 11 Dec 2026 (and 22 Nov, 29 Dec 2026 for Simone) as ahead: post before those dates. Sun 15 cohort card VO says the second pass ran Aug – Dec and the third lands Dec – Mar: fine until 11 Dec 2026. Cards say "open now" (true until 12 Apr 2028). No clip in this batch has a "Today: N°" line.
Text-only posts (X / Threads, Reddit, DMs) are listed with no file. Kit copy is verbatim unless marked as a variant or a correction above.

**Fallbacks and interim reels.** A post that depends on someone else (a reader's quote, a creator's repost) keeps its intent in `note` and stays a hand-made, manual post (`auto: false`). Its `fallback` is a ready video in Rite's own voice that is exported and uploaded as a post of its own the same day (slot "Fallback: …", `fallback_for` in the manifests) and goes out automatically, so the slot is never empty. Choosing: if the original is in hand before that week's Thursday render, set `"use": "original"` on the post (the fallback is dropped from the render, export and upload) and post the original by hand; if it arrives after the week is uploaded, post it by hand and cancel that day's fallback in the queue; `"use": "both"` posts both. Talking-head slots (`asset` = an Anna presenter reel) carry `interim`: until the reel is rendered (needs ElevenLabs credits: `npm run presenter:prep -- <id>`), the export uses the interim version (same cut, no Anna, no voice, music only; `interim: true` in the manifests), and the finished reel replaces it on the next export. See content/scripts/plan-posts.ts.

posts.slot: Instagram: Carousel 3 (the three passes)
posts.caption: Why some people get three Saturn return dates in a year. Swipe for this year's loop and who's in it. Your passes, dated, free at rite.report
alt: Cream card with a gold orbit dial. Large text: Why some people get three Saturn return dates in a year. Small text: Saturn turns direct 11 Dec 2026.
Text slide: Saturn doesn't move in a straight line from our point of view. Each year it stops, backs up for about four and a half months, and stops again.
Text slide headed This year's loop: 27 July 2026, Saturn stops at 14.7 degrees Aries. 11 December 2026, it turns direct at 7.9 degrees Aries.
Text slide: Natal Saturn between 7.9 and 14.7 degrees Aries? It crosses you going forwards (April to July), backwards (August to December, now) and forwards again (December to March). Three passes.
Born 12 March to 6 May 1997, or 10 November 1997 to 21 January 1998? That's you. Second return: 9 May to 16 October 1967, or 30 January to 30 March 1968.
Example, born 1 April 1997 in New York: 13 May 2026, forwards. 15 October 2026, backwards. 3 February 2027, forwards again, the one that settles.
Text slide: Everyone else in Aries gets one clean pass. Neither is better. Three means the theme surfaces, retreats, then settles.
Closing slide: Your passes, dated. rite.report
posts.note: Kit wording with three fixes: the cover says "three Saturn return dates" (it's one return, three passes); slide 4 is shortened and says "backwards (Aug–Dec, now)" instead of "(now)"; slide 5's second-return band starts 30 Jan 1968 (29 Jan is one pass).

posts.slot: Instagram: Carousel 5 (what to do in each phase)
posts.caption: Your Saturn return has three phases: approach, contact, integration. Swipe for the job in each, and which one you're in today. The workbook opens phase by phase at rite.report
alt: Cream card with a gold orbit dial. Large text: Your Saturn return has three phases. Here's the job in each.
Approach (window open, no pass yet): set the thing up. Decide what you're building and write it down. Don't wait for the pass to make the decision for you.
Approach, concretely: one commitment with a daily shape. One agreement you've been avoiding, had out loud.
Contact (the pass, or the three passes): hold. This is where the thing you set up gets tested. The job is to not quit at the first boring stretch.
Contact, concretely: keep the promise small and often. The week before each pass, reread what you wrote in approach.
Integration (after the last pass, until Saturn leaves the sign): consolidate. What you chose becomes structure. Drop the story about yourself that no longer matches what you did.

Your phase today: integration if born April 1996 to early March 1997; contact if born mid-March to early May 1997, or November 1997 to January 1998; approach for everyone else with Saturn in Aries. The window closes for all of Aries on 12 April 2028.
Closing slide: The workbook opens phase by phase. rite.report
posts.note: Slide 7's phase-by-birth-month is true as of 15 Nov 2026 (first-return births; second-return people run on the same degrees).
